verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

verses.he: עַד־אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: How long wilt thou speak these things, Seeing that the words of thy mouth are as a mighty wind?

verses.he: הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת־צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.en: Doth God pervert judgment? Or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

verses.he: אִם־בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־ל֑וֹ וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד־פִּשְׁעָֽם׃
verses.en: If thy children sinned against Him, He delivered them into the hand of their transgression.

verses.he: אִם־אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל־אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.en: If thou wouldest seek earnestly unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;

verses.he: אִם־זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי־עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou wert pure and upright; Surely now He would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy end should greatly increase.

verses.he: כִּֽי־שְׁאַל־נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝כוֹנֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former generation, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out—

verses.he: כִּֽי־תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow—

verses.he: הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?

verses.he: הֲיִֽגְאֶה־גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה־אָ֥חוּ בְלִי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Can the rush shoot up without mire? Can the reed-grass grow without water?

verses.he: עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבּוֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָל־חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, and not cut down, It withereth before any other herb.

verses.he: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑וֹ וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Whose confidence is gossamer, And whose trust is a spider’s web.

verses.he: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל־בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם׃
verses.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand; He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.

verses.he: רָטֹ֣ב ה֖וּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗וֹ יֹֽנַקְתּ֥וֹ תֵצֵֽא׃
verses.en: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.

verses.he: עַל־גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃
verses.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.

verses.he: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him: ‘I have not seen thee.’

verses.he: הֶן־ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃
verses.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, And out of the earth shall others spring.

verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס־תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.en: Behold, God will not cast away an innocent man, Neither will He uphold the evil-doers;

verses.he: עַד־יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: Till He fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.

verses.he: שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.
